items.title: Zelensky prepares for Oslo talks with US envoys as Rubio denies withholding intelligence
items.description: The US secretary of state rejects accusations Ukrainians were dying because the US was withholding intelligence.

items.title: Man charged with attack on Australian MP as suspect's father says she is family friend
items.description: Brendan Nugent's family say they have known Helen Haines, who remains in a critical condition, for more than 20 years.

items.title: Suspect arrested after historic town hall set alight - French media
items.description: The spire of the clock tower at Limoges city hall dramatically collapsed as it was engulfed in flames on Saturday.

items.title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police
items.description: Almost 300 people have been injured, more than half of them police, as violent anti-government demonstrations show no sign of easing.

items.title: Tourist found guilty after stealing Las Vegas flamingo from enclosure
items.description: The man testified that he snatched Peachy from its enclosure at the Flamingo hotel and casino after drinking 30 to 40 beers, but did not mean any harm.

items.title: Why Israeli Gen Z voters are drawn to the far right
items.description: More than half a million young people will cast their ballots in Israel next week - and they could make all the difference.

items.title: Residents warned not to drink tap water after hundreds fall sick near South Africa capital
items.description: More than 400 people, mostly children, become ill after drinking contaminated water, east of Pretoria.

items.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
items.description: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

items.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
items.description: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

items.title: Tennis star Svitolina says emotional toll of Ukraine war led to Monfils separation
items.description: The two top tennis pros married in 2021 and have one child together.

items.title: Vinted blocks French looters listing stolen goods for sale
items.description: The platform said since the weekend it had "taken immediate action to identify and remove listings linked to looting".

items.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting bug had Saudi support, claims prosecutors
items.description: Abdulrahman Alfozan, who is accused of planting a recording device, has been denied bail.

claude-code.name: Navide
claude-code.description: Navide is an open-source Agentic Development Environment (ADE) that orchestrates AI software teams across the software development lifecycle. Coordinate AI agents, workflows, context, and human collaboration from idea to deployment.

claude-code.name: pipeshub-ai
claude-code.description: The open-source context layer for AI agents. PipesHub turns your company's knowledge (Slack, Drive, Jira, GitHub, Microsoft 365 and 40+ connectors) into a permission-aware workspace that agents can search, grep, navigate and cite. MCP, SDKs and built-in agents. Self-hosted.

claude-code.description: Agent-assisted maintainership and development framework for Apache projects — Triage, Mentoring, Drafting (agent-authored fixes with human review), and Pairing (developer-side dev-cycle) skills shipping; Agentic Autonomous (auto-merge) on the roadmap.

claude-code.name: claude-code-usage-statusline
